Cozy Mystery · Acorn TV Original · 2019–2021

Queens of Mystery

2 Series 6 Two-Part Mysteries Narrated by Juliet Stevenson Wildemarsh Filmed in Kent

Young detective Matilda Stone returns to her home village of Wildemarsh and finds herself solving murders with help from her three aunts, all crime novelists. Created by Julian Unthank and narrated like a storybook by Juliet Stevenson, Queens of Mystery ran for two series of three two-part mysteries each, in 2019 and 2021. It's an Acorn TV Original and streams on Acorn TV in the US. See how the services compare in British TV Hub's guide to where to watch British TV in the US.

What Makes the Series Special

Style

A Storybook Mystery

Juliet Stevenson's narration and the show's bold, colourful look give it the feel of a fairy tale, quite unlike any other British cozy mystery.

At a Glance
ToneWhimsical, theatrical
Family

Three Crime-Writing Aunts

Matilda's aunts bring their novelists' instincts to every case, and their rivalry and affection give the show much of its humour.

At a Glance
AuntsCat, Beth & Jane
Easy to Finish

A Short, Complete Watch

With six two-part mysteries in total, it's an easy series to enjoy over a long weekend.

At a Glance
Stories6 two-parters

Setting and Filming Locations

Setting & Filming

Wildemarsh, Filmed in Kent

The fictional village of Wildemarsh was brought to life in Kent, with filming around Cranbrook, Farningham, Smarden, and Benenden, and at Lympne Castle.

At a Glance
SettingWildemarsh (fictional)
CountyKent

Frequently Asked Questions

Streaming

Where can I watch Queens of Mystery in the US?

Queens of Mystery is an Acorn TV Original and streams on Acorn TV in the US, including through the Acorn TV channel on Amazon Prime Video.

Quick Answer
PrimaryAcorn TV
Episode Count

How many episodes of Queens of Mystery are there?

There are two series, each with three two-part mysteries, for 12 episodes in total.

Quick Answer
Episodes12
Stories6
Status

Will there be a Series 3 of Queens of Mystery?

As of September 2026, a third series has not been announced.

Quick Answer
Series 3Not announced
Cast

Why does Matilda look different in Series 2?

The role of Matilda Stone was recast for the second series, with Florence Hall taking over from Olivia Vinall.

Quick Answer
Series 1Olivia Vinall
Series 2Florence Hall
Filming Location

Where was Queens of Mystery filmed?

The series was filmed in Kent, including around Cranbrook, Farningham, Smarden, and Benenden.

Quick Answer
CountyKent
